avis.titre: So far I love this product
avis.texte: I will continue to use this product. I love this product instantly!

avis.titre: Love it on my second bottle already
avis.texte: I tried it out to see if it would work and it did and it lasted me longer than i thought it would. Definitely going to continue to buy.

I do like this. It took a few times for me to love it. I was used to the feeling of the Hyla B5 serum that feels and smells amazing. This is more of a stringent type experience and for me, dries a bit sticky. I am happy with the results.

Product is described to be a dark spot corrector, but the actual bottle does not say that. This product caused my dark spots to get darker and bumpy. This happened after two uses as prescribed in the instructions. I threw the product away and I never do that. It was horrible and I caution you not to purchase or use this product.

I have been suffering with hormonal acne since 14 and have lots of dark spots and scars. I've been using this for about a year now and it makes a big difference. It doesn't clog my pores and it brightens my skin, it's definitely worth the money
I've been using this product and it does clear dark spots. However, like with any other product of this tupe, you have to be consistent.

avis.titre: Works very well with sensitive skin!
avis.texte: So being a skin care girly for some time I learned that glycolic acid helps with uneven skin tone. However, its a very powerful acid so it doesnt play well with alot of serums/acids. For people using this product heres some tips so that your skin doesnt burn, get irritated, or mess with your skin barrier.... use it only at night, do not mix it with any other acids such as lactic acid, AHA/BHAs, or niacinamides. It works well with ceremide serum, ampoule, and snail mucin. So its very important you read the ingredients of other products you layer with this. If you use this once a week or so you will see the benefits.

I used this product several years ago when my skin discolored after having kids. It worked really well and once I was happy with my clear skin, I use exfoliating scrubs and always sunscreen now. My face never got the brown spots back. Use sparingly, but often. Wash hand before applying moisturizer too. Dont get on eyelids.
Really Love this product ! My skin look better when I use this product

avis.titre: Do not use on sensitive skin or dark skin.
avis.texte: It gave me dark spots around my mouth making me look older. I have melisma and this has made it worse and caused more areas to darken.

avis.titre: Messy and stays sticky on the skin.....
avis.texte: I tried this serum based on my dermatologist recommendations. However, the packaging is a HUGE problem - it comes with a screw on cap and an eye dropped is included in the box. But the eye dropper doesn't fit the top of the bottle securely, causing the serum to leak out and get all over everything. Plus I found the serum to be too "wet" and stay very sticky/tacky for way too long. And I only used a few drops on my face. This is being returned to the store where I purchased it and I do not recommend it.

I have been using this serum for a year. I noticed a much improved look and feel of my skin. I stopped for a short period and returned after noticing my skin dull and had dry dead skin on my face. I would highly recommend this product. My skin is very sensitive and I can use this product.
I've been doing this for three weeks now and I can't say I see any fading of my age spots. My dermatologist recommended this product. I will keep trying to s if it makes a difference.
The smells wasn't too good. And my skin feel burn and hurt after apply on it every time.

avis.titre: Glycolic B5 10% Pure Glycolic Acid Serum. Great!!!
avis.texte: My Wife loves this product!! She swears by it, because it really works to remove age spots on her face. It isn't instant, but it definitely works over a short period of time.

avis.titre: Good Product for fading dark spots
avis.texte: The Product is very good. A few weeks I can already see my dark spots fading. The only reason I didn't give it five stars is that the dropper does not fit correctly on the bottle. It does not screw on tight. This causes the product to leak and be exposed to air.
The product turned dark brown and I can't open the dropper any more, looks like product have turn like a glue. So disappointed! The expiration date is 08/24
I've used this product for the last 4 months. It's absolutely ineffective on my sunspots. I've been using the sunscreen for YEARS! But this product is like a placebo. I'm thoroughly dissapointed.

avis.titre: The best complement for my beauty routine!
avis.texte: Love this serum as it maintains skin tone even and beautiful, I use it now as a weekly compliment for my beauty routine, the results are fantastic! Thanks la Roche!
I couldn't believe how well this product worked. I have been using this for 6 months and it works!
This product has changed my skin and even helped my teenage daughter's skin !

I have been using this product now for three weeks and it has made it skin look about 10 years older! Even though I've applied face oil every day this product makes my skin super dry. So disappointed. I love your other products but this one was a huge waste of money.
Dark spots look more clear and dark spots are more invisible after using this products for weeks
Doesn't work. My dark spots are still as noticeable as they were before I started this.
I switched from Epanouie and cannot be happier. I've literally seen results within two weeks.

avis.titre: Why has the serum turned brown
avis.texte: Started working well lightening dark spots, however, it has turned brown and smells. Expiration date is 08/2025. I purchased 2 bottles and both have turned brown. Is it safe to use?

I wanted this product to work for my dark spots. Unfortunately, it did nothing for me. On to the next product.

I get melasma pretty bad on my face during the summer months, but I started using this a little over a week ago and can already see the dark spots lightening. I will continue to buy this! Also, my overall skin appearance just looks so much better and vibrant. Great product.
Terrible, it dried my face really bad my face burned the only two times o used this product
I used this product once and it burnt my face. My face tingles and gets hot. Should I continue using this or am I having a reaction?
Ordered this through another company for the first time. This is a miracle in a bottle for my skin type.

noticed a big difference in my little dark spots quickly with this. the smell isn't good but also not bad, worth it for the results either way. knocking a star because the packaging is trash they really need to consider a better dropper.

I have been using this product for 2months now and do not see any change.. I mean even a little bit. I do not recommend this product to anyone. Save your money and time.

This is the La Roche Posay glycolic B5 serum and it helps with brightening and dark spots. I don't struggle with dark spots so I'm not sure how well it works for those, it definitely brightens. It is lightweight and oil free, I add a little to my moisturizer and really like how it helps awaken my skin. It took about 2 weeks of using this that I was able to see a difference in my skin. Love it! After a few days of use, my skin started to glow. Really works well for me.

I have acne, for years now! spent so much money on acne products. everyone's skin different! I see a difference in my acne scars! Within couple of days. I use this almost every night.
This product is amazing. It leaves my face feeling silky smooth and I noticed my complexion is brighter.
This has lightened my sun spots. This product does not dry out my skin. I would repurchase. Always wear a sunscreen all year and when you are older it will keep down the damage.
My favorite product because it has already lighten the discoloration I have around my lips. It is light and very fresh on the skin at night. Love love this product.

I did not get this for dark spots. However, I had a thing under one eye and this got rid of it. It does not dry my skin, but I do have very oily skin and I use it every other day.

Heavenly soft scent, have been using this product for 2 weeks with great results, love it

avis.titre: Great product!  I've continued to buy it.

I am not sure why they had to make this such a chemical smell. I couldn't finish it. Thank you so much #Influenster appreciate the help and this awesome trial. Just wasn't for me based on scent.
I am a skeptic when it comes to serums- especially since it seems like most of them do the same thing. I really liked the consistency of this serum and was happy with the results!
It helped to minimize dark spots that have been there for a while. This product is very effective and I would say everyone should at least try for their selves, you won't be disappointed.

avis.titre: It's good, but I've used better serums
avis.texte: This serum is pretty tacky. And while that's nice if you're a daily makeup user, it just isn't as emollient as I would like my serums to be. I have used better brands.

I used this every night for several weeks and it did amazing on my skin. I have extremely dark spots on my neck and you can see them visibly fading away. So glad that I was able to try this product out. I will definitely be buying this to keep in my nightly regimen. La Roche-Posay Glycolic B5 10% Pure Glycolic Acid Serum
Serum has improved skin texture and appearance, especially if you are looking for a "glow." If your skin is ultra-sensitive, I would do half this serum and half Toleriane night moisturizer.
Tested this on my hands, mainly for age spots. It fade them and made my hands softer. I liked the packaging and the smell as well.

I got really bad hyper pigmentation during my last pregnancy; I'm super insecure about it, and while I've noticed a difference, it hasn't been as much as I've expected. I think there's some room for improvement, it would be good to know what order to apply it, when using in conjunction with other products...
I love this , im combination skin and this works great for me. I add moisturizer for when im feeling more dry.

avis.titre: Not bad but not the best
avis.texte: This product is ok. I haven't l noticed any major differences in my skin though and I hate the sticky feeling it leaves after you apply it. I will continue to use it though and will hopefully see results with longer, more consistent use.

avis.titre: Not sure if this did much for me…
avis.texte: I don't have as many dark spots as I used to, so it's hard to say if this product helped much! It was fairly easy to apply, although the "medicine dropper" dispenser was a bit strange and messy. As someone with sensitive skin, I'm always cautious with new products but I didn't have any issues with this. It doesn't smell great, but I wasn't expecting it to have any fragrance anyway! I'm relieved that it didn't dry out my face after applying, so I could easily use some before bed. I didn't see any residue or discoloration on my pillowcase (which is always a plus!)
Noticeable difference in 2 uses. This stuff is amazing. My skin is clearer and brighter than it ever has been

I've been very frustrated with the dark spots on my skin that never fade no matter what product I used. But when I tried La Roche Posay after two weeks of using it, I was surprised how it brightened my skin like never before. It did sting a little bit at first but it was tolerable. Overall, I'm very happy with the results and definitely adding this to my daily skin routine!

I want to start off by saying my only gripe was it lightened my freckles but I understood that would happen. Other than that I am in love! I've gotten many compliments over my skin and how youthful it's made me look. I would definitely purchase this and try if you haven't.

avis.titre: Great product, but not for sensitive skin
avis.texte: I firmly believe in the quality of LaRoche Posay products and that with continued use, users will get their desired results. Unfortunately I was unable to use the product for more than one week as the alcohol in it was incredibly drying for my skin. The consistency is nice, but it has a very strong smell. If you have sensitive or dry skin, you might want to consider using a different product.

avis.titre: Quality Glycolic Serum.. Not my favorite...
avis.texte: Knowing that LA ROCHE-POSAY is quality brand, I believe this serum is/will do what it is intended to do (reducing dark spots & helping skin tone is my main concern). I'm a big fan of serums but this one is not my favorite. It smells like nail polish remover to me and I would prefer a more pleasant or neutral scent. I do like it's consistency though, not too thin, not too thick.
This serum is great! I noticed a difference in just a couple of weeks. Skin feels soft and dark spots have lightened a bit. I would be careful not to use too much if you have sensitive skin.

I was so excited to receive this product! I'm a fan of the brand and know it has a big following. If this is your first product buying from them it's perfect. Since starting this serum I noticed a brighter complexion and you get looking skin. It has a unique texture to touch almost gel-like, but it dries pretty fast and it's not sticky.

I didn't really know what to expect from this, I have heard great things about LaRosche so was excited to try! After two weeks of trying this as directed I saw a major improvement in some dark spots from past breakouts, and overall brighter tone to my skin. I enjoyed trying it, and recommend for anyone looking to even out tone.
I'm not sure I've used this long enough to see great results, but I do feel like it works. I haven't finished the bottle, so I will for sure do that and follow up again!
I was so happy to try this because I am a huge fan of this brand! My skin looked more fresh & awake for the first time in a year!

I really liked this serum. I felt like it made my skin softer, and gave it better tone. The only improvement I would make is a better price point. This was my first time using this product that I got free from influenster to try out and review.
Not overwhelmed or underwhelmed. Just whelmed. The packaging was good. Strong scent was strong. I didn't see much of a difference. ￼￼

This is a nice hydrating serum. Smells like grapefruit/citrus possibly. Smell is ok but not my favorite. I do love how hydrating it is and do feel it added radiance to my skin. Think this is a great addition to my serums and I would purchase again especially for winter time when my skin is dry. Not sure it replaces my holy grail lauder ANR, but I would use this along with it for sure. Definitely noticed an improvement in my skin when using this.

I'm 28 and started noticing a few dark spots from sun damage over the years. This product has significantly reduced their appearance and has helped the overall evenness of my skin tone. Super happy with this product and the price point is so much kore affordable than other options. I will definitely continue to purchase in the future.
It was a great Product for my skin and it do wonders like some fine lines that i had. It was really gentle on my skin. The only thing that I don't like is the price of the serum.

I received this product to try in exchange for my review. I did not mind this product. I felt the Serum did have a bit of a sting to it as well as a stronger smell. besides that I feel the Serum did help with dark spots. I will continue to keep using this see long term if this will help fade dark spots.

I received this product through Influenster. I REALLY wanted to love it. La Roche Posay is a great brand. I found this product to have an odd smell that I couldn't get past. It was so thick and sticky. I honestly didn't use the product enough to give an honest opinion of it's ability to correct darkspots.
